text: At 2.1.27 `list-plans` has `rest: direct` and its `zachowanie` orders by `created_at` ascending (ties by `path`) with the M39 implicit-matrix window; `m10api00` says the `/plans` page list comes from `get-api-artifacts-kind` with `:kind=plan`, whose description leaves the order to the owning module. The active AC `ac-planservice-listplans-search-limit` still says the plan list opens ordered by the most recently changed plan. Two places name two orders for what may be one list, and the generic list route has no `total`/`hasMore` nor a finite default limit (the implicit matrix asks for both). Built: `GET /api/artifacts/plan` answers in the `list_plans` order (created_at asc, path tie), filters by `applied`, and windows with `limit`/`offset` only when the caller passes them (the `list_briefs` precedent of the same route), without `total`/`hasMore`; the `/plans` page re-sorts the rows client-side (updatedAt desc) so the AC holds. Please state whether the page order is a UI concern (as built) or whether the AC should be retired/rewritten, and whether the REST rendering of a list operation on the generic artifact route must carry `total`/`hasMore` and a default limit.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-2701 — REST list = list_plans order (window only when asked); /plans page sorts by last change client-side
